title: Plain Transformers Can be Powerful Graph Learners
abstract: arXiv:2504.12588v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transformers have attained outstanding performance across various modalities, owing to their simple but powerful scaled-dot-product (SDP) attention mechanisms. Researchers have attempted to migrate Transformers to graph learning, but most advanced Graph Transformers (GTs) have strayed far from plain Transformers, exhibiting major architectural differences either by integrating message-passing or incorporating sophisticated attention mechanisms. These divergences hinder the easy adoption of training advances for Transformers developed in other domains. Contrary to previous GTs, this work demonstrates that the plain Transformer architecture can be a powerful graph learner. translated_title: 普通Transformer也能成为强大的图学习器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2504.12588v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：Transformer凭借其简单而强大的缩放点积（SDP）注意力机制，在各种模态中取得了卓越的性能。研究人员曾尝试将Transformer迁移到图学习中，但大多数先进的图Transformer（GTs）已偏离普通Transformer，要么集成消息传递机制，要么引入复杂的注意力机制，在架构上存在重大差异。这些分歧阻碍了将其他领域中Transformer训练进展轻松应用于图学习。与以往的GTs不同，本研究证明普通Transformer架构可以成为强大的图学习器。为此，我们提出对普通Transformer架构进行三项简单、最小且易于实现的修改，以构建我们的强大普通图Transformer（PPGT）：（1）简化$L_2$注意力以衡量幅度。
tldr: 本文证明普通Transformer架构通过三项简单修改（如简化L2注意力）即可成为强大的图学习器，无需复杂架构改动。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that a plain Transformer architecture can be a powerful graph learner with just three simple modifications, such as simplified L2 attention, without complex architectural changes.
